text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the clinical staff, including Betzahi, Yami, Maria, and Ari, for their empathy and welcoming support. Reviewers highlight that doctors and veterinary assistants take time to listen, provide comfort during emergencies, and never pressure owners into unnecessary services.

Clients describe exceptional care for their canine companions across all life stages, from routine puppy vaccinations to gentle end-of-life support for senior dogs. Reviewers emphasize that the team handles both urgent conditions and delicate farewells with remarkable gentleness and dignity.

Reviewers appreciate the thorough communication provided throughout treatments and diagnoses. Staff members clearly outline medical concerns, explain prescribed medications in understandable terms, and send thoughtful handwritten sympathy cards during difficult moments.

q.en: Does the hospital accommodate urgent or same-day pet visits?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report being accommodated promptly for sudden illnesses and urgent medical issues.

q.en: Are routine vaccinations and checkups offered?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently bring their dogs for core vaccination updates, wellness checks, and nail trims.

q.en: How do reviewers view the clinic atmosphere?

a.en: Clients note that the facility is exceptionally clean, welcoming, and free from strong pet odours.

q.en: Does the clinic offer pet financing options?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that the practice provides third-party financing to assist with unexpected veterinary costs.
